fit_reason: Whole pickup truck listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Headlights look yellowed and hazy on the front of the truck
Silver paint looks flat and dull across the hood, cab and bed sides
Dark lower body cladding and fender flares look faded and gray, with dirt marks along the driver side rocker area
Rear bumper chrome and lower tailgate area look dusty and spotted
Engine bay is dusty and grimy around the hoses, fluid reservoirs and fan shroud
message: Hi Jim, we saw your listing for the Dakota. The headlights look a bit hazy and the black lower trim has faded to gray in the photos, both things that clean up well. We do mobile pre-sale details, including headlight and trim restoration and a paint buff, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
